mandate: C322 — test the cross-sectional VWAP-CLOSE FAIR-VALUE DISLOCATION mean-reversion statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1440 pre-registered configs). Signals (score = -fair-value-dislocation, long VWAP-cheap / short VWAP-rich): vwap_dev (log_close vs trailing same-tod mean log_vwap), vwap_z (z-scored dev), close_vwap_spread ((close-vwap)/vwap vs trailing same-tod mean), vwap_ewm (log_close vs causal ewm same-tod log_vwap), vwap_vol_z ((close-vwap)/vwap scaled by trailing same-tod log_return std). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (symmetric and perp_heavy). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, and vwap-vs-placebo attribution. vwap-NaN policy applied (NaN-aware trailing stats, min_periods=L; NaN-feature assets weight 0).

methodology.buckets: bar-of-day (tod)=seconds-of-day//300 (0..287), exact 288 bars per UTC day.
methodology.fair_value_anchor: real 5m vwap (volume-weighted trade price) and log_vwap=log(vwap) where vwap>0 else NaN (PRE-REGISTERED vwap-NaN POLICY); vwap NaNs only at total_volume==0 bars.
methodology.signals: vwap_dev=-(log_close-mean_L(log_vwap@tod)); vwap_z=-((log_close-mean_L)/std_L(log_vwap@tod)); close_vwap_spread=-((close-vwap)/vwap - mean_L((close-vwap)/vwap@tod)); vwap_ewm=-(log_close-ewm_mean_L(log_vwap@tod)); vwap_vol_z=-(((close-vwap)/vwap)/std_L(log_return@tod)). lookback L days = trailing L seasonal occurrences, min_periods=L, NaN-aware (exclude NaN obs), fail-closed. score=-dislocation; causal shift(1), cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-signal assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; symmetric = fee+slip; perp_heavy = 1.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1440 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference config vwap nets vs placebo_noise (per-asset permuted returns, same positions); shares=|net|/sum(|buckets|).
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
